extension.summary: Kodi's dialogs for Media Center 98 in NEO98
extension.description: Tells Media Center 98, the Windows 98 program of NEO98, which dialog Kodi shows (a question, a choice, a sign-in) and answers it the way the user did there. It listens only on this computer (127.0.0.1, port 9779). NEO98 installs it with its host media integration.
